title: Issue Installing Template
description:
Hi, 
I saw that this repository was recommended as a template for users interested in extending the available architectures within the R torch package. I have tried installing the package but have encountered issues when trying to load the installed package.

When I clone the repository and then run devtools::install(), running library(lltm) renders the following error:
```
> library(lltm)
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘lltm’:
 .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'lltm', details:
  call: inDL(x, as.logical(local), as.logical(now), ...)
  error: unable to load shared object 'C:/Users/User/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.2/lltm/bin/lltm.dll':
  LoadLibrary failure:  The specified procedure could not be found.
```
I also tried installing directly from github using the devtools::install_github command as mentioned in your README. This also installs successfully but renders the following when loading:
```
library(lltm) 
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘lltm’:  .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'lltm', details:   call: fun(libname, pkgname)   error: could not find function "fun"
```
I am currently running R 4.2.2 and using the most recent version of torch on CRAN. The torch package works just fine when I use it. I see that the last commit was two years ago. Is the repository still active and have you encountered this issue before?

Any help with this would be greatly appreciated.
